reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output; the cited text is left unchanged.

§§ 14.1–14.4 support the preferred position: Customer owns Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information and independently developed IP with only a limited processing right to Vendor; Vendor makes a present assignment of Deliverables (plus personnel assignments and further assurances); Vendor retains only Vendor Technology with the perpetual licence in § 13.2 applying to embedded Vendor Technology; joint ownership is excluded absent a separate signed instrument and feedback is voluntary with Customer retaining unrestricted rights.
No walk-away features are present — there is no assignment of Customer IP or Customer Data to Vendor and no unrestricted joint ownership — so raising a deviation would have been over-flagging.

The rationale correctly relegates the minor carve-outs (anonymized telemetry excluded from Customer Data in § 1.3; unaided-memory know-how excluded from Deliverables in § 1.4) to notes rather than deviations, consistent with the playbook's treatment of customary sub-elements.
Deterministic check confirms no residual assignment of Customer Data/IP to Vendor; the inclusion of the unrelated heading paragraph p0049 is cosmetic and does not affect the finding.
